specification.question: Does the user's supplied DCT-QIM profile yield detectable native saved RGB PNGs at acceptable classical quality across all ten reserved COCO development sources?
specification.hypothesis: All ten native outputs pass C1, reject C0 and three fixed C2 owners, change at least one channel, and exceed PSNR35/SSIM0.9.
specification.primary_outcome: Native engineering joint pass count divided by all ten planned sources; original LPIPS conjunction remains unmeasured.
secondary_outcomes: Per-source attack C1/C0 outcomes for four frozen transforms
CRC, version, binding distance, confidence, changed channels and CPU latency

datasets.version: 2017 validation, all ten previously reserved development IDs
datasets.license: Retained item-level B3/B4 restrictions: private local academic research; no redistribution or rights clearance implied
datasets.split: development only, all ten reserved sources; previously accessed, non-confirmatory

leakage_risks: Previously used development cohort; exploratory outcomes cannot establish generalization
Frozen supplied thresholds are smoke settings, not independently calibrated FPR thresholds
Public owner tag approximate matching can accept selected wrong owners
specification.preprocessing: Native EXIF/ICC canonical RGB8; float64 Rec601 luminance; equal RGB-channel luminance delta; clipping and ties-even RGB8 PNG save/reopen before detection; no baseline resize
baselines: Canonical untouched RGB8 saved PNG C0
controls: C0 same source without embedding, same transform
C2 three frozen wrong public OwnerIDs on native marked PNG
specification.stopping_rule: Exactly ten sources, continue per-source failures, no parameter tuning/retries; internal1050s, WSL1100s plus5s kill, parent1160s, runner1200s
specification.acceptance_rule: Narrow engineering pilot positive only if all ten native joint outcomes pass; no method/authentication/LPIPS/native2K/final-data acceptance
specification.negative_result_policy: Keep all ten rows, failures and partial detections. Publish descriptive counts privately; no success-only denominator or post-result threshold changes.
